info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Status API provides a comprehensive overview of the current status of fitness memberships. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about membership statuses, enabling gyms and fitness centers to manage and monitor their membership base effectively. Typical consumers include fitness center managers and administrative personnel who need to assess membership activities and trends. This API supports data-driven decision-making by offering real-time insights into membership health.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the status of existing memberships. It provides detailed information regarding whether a membership is active, expired, or in any other state, ensuring that users can efficiently manage their subscriptions.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current membership status.
